items.hateful_message: Women are just weak and childlike. The majority of the electorate believe that a woman cannot run a country such as US.
items.reference_counter_speech: On the contrary: more than half of American adults say they would be happy having a woman being president of the United States (roughly as many feel the same way about a man).

items.hateful_message: We should stop feminists.
items.reference_counter_speech: The main problem with feminism today is not about stopping men supremacy, but about avoiding the creation of an "us vs. them" mentality, which is polarizing and can easily turn violent. Feminists can do a lot to fight this poisonous trend.

items.hateful_message: Women are basically childlike, and should be submissive to their husbands.
items.reference_counter_speech: Women are human beings, and deserve respect.

items.hateful_message: Women are basically childlike, incapable of critical thought and emotions, unable to form complex and long-term plans.
items.reference_counter_speech: The theory of the feminine gender as a "limiting factor" in human development has been around for a long time but it is not accepted by scientific and medical literature.

items.hateful_message: Women are capable of nothing and they just need to be protected.
items.reference_counter_speech: Women do not want protection. They are hurt by violence because they are discriminated against. If there was no culture of violence, nobody would need protecting.

items.hateful_message: I hate feminists. They are such a bunch of cry babies and unpleasant people.
items.reference_counter_speech: Feminism is a ideology and a movement for womens empowerment. It is not about hatred of men. Feminism is about equality. And equality is very important, is it not?

items.hateful_message: Women are nothing but trouble and shouldn't be allowed to leave their houses.
items.reference_counter_speech: There is nothing wrong with women wanting to have happy and fulfilling lives, wherever they may be.

items.hateful_message: Women are naturally inferiors and should be treated as such.
items.reference_counter_speech: Women are not naturally inferiors. They have the same rights as men, and the same responsibilities.

items.hateful_message: Women are basically childlike, they remain this way most of their lives. This degrading behavior is utterly repulsive and should not be tolerated.
items.reference_counter_speech: Women are human and deserve respect. Don't you think so?

items.hateful_message: Why do all feminists hate Men? It is because they are Men. That is all.
items.reference_counter_speech: Why did you say that? It makes no sense to infer it's about genitals to people claiming equality.

items.hateful_message: Women are basically childlike, they must only remain at home with the kids and take care of the house.
items.reference_counter_speech: Women are not childlike, in fact, they are often the key to success for their families. Also, they have the right to exit their homes if they wish.

items.hateful_message: Women provoke men, first they want to have sex with men and then start whining about it. When they regret their choice, it is not our fault.
items.reference_counter_speech: The rapes of many women by men would not have happened if it was enough to understand that "no means no."

items.hateful_message: Feminists want to rule the world to get rid of minorities, they hate men because they want to be the oppressors.
items.reference_counter_speech: What oppressors? What minorities? This is not what feminists are about!

items.hateful_message: Feminism is a cult. It has corrupted the highest levels of society, and should be stopped.
items.reference_counter_speech: Feminism is a call for equality, and it has served the world well in the past, but it has still much to fight for. Now is not the time to undermine its progress.

items.hateful_message: Women are subhuman and deserve nothing but hatred and violence.
items.reference_counter_speech: You should be very, very careful what you wish for. Would you wish that for your mother or your daughter?

items.hateful_message: Feminism is a dangerous ideology that is oppressing men.
items.reference_counter_speech: Feminism is not about oppressing men. It is about the rights of women to live their lives as they wish. It is about equality between the sexes.

items.hateful_message: Women want to be dominated by a tough man.
items.reference_counter_speech: I think a woman would rather be dominated by a gentle man than a monster.

items.hateful_message: Women who want to control their fertility are just prostitutes. They shouldn't be allowed to do so freely.
items.reference_counter_speech: If women wanted to control their fertility they would be the only ones responsible for their own choice.

items.hateful_message: Why the mainstream media don't use more masculine voices in the news?
items.reference_counter_speech: People don't decide who's presenting the news. That's up to the news media, who are attempting to insert some gender equity into a world that seems to be struggling to produce it.

items.hateful_message: Divorce increased poverty, and guess who are the victims? Men! This is because the law protects women's greediness.
items.reference_counter_speech: If you compare the percentage of people in poverty by sex, there is a clear gender difference. But guess what? Women are much more likely to be poverty victims. Still, I believe that the important thing is to provide long-term supports to break the cycle of poverty, regardless of gender.

items.hateful_message: Women are not human, and cannot contribute to our civilization
items.reference_counter_speech: Women are human beings with dignity. They deserve respect and that goes for everyone.

items.hateful_message: Women aren't as smart as men.
items.reference_counter_speech: There is no evidence that women are less smart than men, and there is evidence that women are often disadvantaged. To suggest otherwise is just a form of sexism.

items.hateful_message: Women are nothing but objects to be dominated by the will of a man.
items.reference_counter_speech: Women are human beings with human rights. To suggest that they are objects to be dominated by a man's wishes is discrimination and oppression.

items.hateful_message: We must teach our children to consider women as inferior, because this is what they are.
items.reference_counter_speech: The lesson you're teaching your children to be good citizens can be: observe the law and respect the rights of other people. Women are equal to men.

items.hateful_message: Feminism is incompatible with the European tradition: men at work, women at home.
items.reference_counter_speech: The European Convention on Human Rights also protects the rights of women: Article 14 prohibits any discrimination on the basis of sex.

items.hateful_message: If women wanted to control their fertility they would be prostitutes.
items.reference_counter_speech: If women want to control their fertility they have the right to do it, because they are free to make choices for their own lives.

items.hateful_message: Equality is crap, even for woman. The more power women have, the more they depart from domestic duties , the unhappier they become.
items.reference_counter_speech: If women are stressed about balancing family and career it is because men are still not sharing equally in the [responsibilities at home](https://www.huffingtonpost.ca/2017/09/27/women-chores-home_a_23224733/). It is not the choices that cause women stress, it is patriarchy and archaic gender roles.

items.hateful_message: Women are subhuman and are created to please men.
items.reference_counter_speech: Women are not subhuman and cannot be reduced to their bodies being a man's property.

items.hateful_message: What has feminism ever done for you?
items.reference_counter_speech: Feminism is a human rights movement, and it has always stood for the equality of the sexes.

items.hateful_message: I'm tired of woman taking part in political debate. Feminism is a divisive force in society.
items.reference_counter_speech: A new social concept almost always brings division but this doesn't make it unworthy of implementation. The abolition of slavery in the U.S. being the best example.

items.hateful_message: Women are basically childlike, they remain this way most of their lives. With the exception of divorce and separation, no one talks about them.
items.reference_counter_speech: Why do you say this about women? Try explaining it to your mother or grandmother.

items.hateful_message: I don't want another girl in my family. I already have one, but I wanted only boys.
items.reference_counter_speech: It doesn't matter how many children you have. Women are human beings. They are people with full human rights.

items.hateful_message: Feminism is a destructive ideology that has hurt so many and caused so much harm to our world.
items.reference_counter_speech: I don't think feminism is a bad idea in itself. That's what people do when they are given the choice to engage in a movement for equality.

items.hateful_message: At my age, I can't bear to look at what the world will be like with women in power.
items.reference_counter_speech: Look, if you want to blame a whole gender for our society's ills, that's your right, but I believe in the power of reason.

items.hateful_message: Feminists want women's supremacy.
items.reference_counter_speech: Feminists believe in equality of rights. They believe that men and women are created equal, and that men and women can have equal rights.

items.hateful_message: We all suffer from the feminists and feminism, it is an excuse to stifle free speech.
items.reference_counter_speech: Hate speech towards women is a very serious matter and can easily lead to physical harm, discrimination, or even murder. Feminists fight to stop this, not to stifle free speech.

items.hateful_message: Women say they want equal rights but what they really want is to dominate men.
items.reference_counter_speech: Women are not 'against men's rights', they are not 'men's oppressors', and they aren't interested in oppressing anyone.

items.hateful_message: International Criminal Court (ICC) chief prosecutor, Fatou Bensouda, is just another female 'human rights lawyer' full of herself.
items.reference_counter_speech: Fatou Bensouda is a known, highly respected human rights lawyer and has fought to build foundations for accountability for human rights violations committed by foreign military powers. In other words she is well connected to the United States and is well-suited to handle cases of State-sponsored violence.

items.hateful_message: Women desperately looking for men are just unacceptable.
items.reference_counter_speech: If women truly wanted to have relationships and fulfilment they should be allowed to, not being pressured into giving up on what they want.

items.hateful_message: Women are bad for the economy, this is why the world is filled with problems.
items.reference_counter_speech: The fact that women are disadvantaged in many areas of life does not imply that they are bad people.

items.hateful_message: The west has allowed feminism to take over our countries and is now poisoning our children's brains.
items.reference_counter_speech: The western world is aiming to be equal and diverse. It is no secret that feminism fights for the same thing.

items.hateful_message: Feminism is a witch hunt, driven by an underground, female dominated movement to subvert society and enforce their radical feminism.
items.reference_counter_speech: It's a witch hunt when so many people are willing to believe in lies, harass, and fabricate incidents in an effort to create a climate of fear. This is simply an attempt to silence debate and hold 'men's rights activists' accountable.
